clue.text: Judge employed after Officer in Charge changed objective

indicators.note: after places the word for employed behind the officer's abbreviation

parts.note: a ref, short for referee, judges a match
OC is the standard abbreviation for Officer Commanding or in Charge
something employed has been used

explanation.surface: A judge, put to work under a commanding officer, switches what they are aiming at.
explanation.definitionFit: To refocus is to shift one's aim or attention, so having refocused means having altered one's goal.

clue.text: Fight fires with campers' equipment

parts.note: a ruck is a rough scrap or brawl
to fire someone is to sack them

explanation.surface: Someone fights a blaze using whatever gear campers have to hand.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fires' reads as flames, but here it is the verb: dismisses from a job.
explanation.definitionFit: Backpacks are the bags hikers and campers carry their kit in.

clue.text: Repercussion of holding almost everything in disregard

indicators.note: holding means the word for disregard wraps round the shortened word

parts.note: to flout a rule is to disregard it

indicators.note: almost means the final letter of the word for everything is dropped

parts.note: all means everything

explanation.surface: A consequence of ignoring nearly every rule there is.
explanation.walkthrough: 'almost' drops the last letter of the word for everything; 'holding' wraps the word for disregard round what is left. 'in' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: The fallout from an event is its aftermath or consequences.

clue.text: Some ensure loo cleanliness on the rise in jail

indicators.note: in a down clue on the rise means the letters are read upwards, so backwards
some of these words means a run of their letters is taken

explanation.surface: Part of keeping a prison clean is making sure the toilets are spotless.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Some' picks RELOOC from ensuRE LOO Cleanliness; 'on the rise' turns it upwards in this down answer.
explanation.definitionFit: The cooler is slang for prison, a place to cool one's heels.

clue.text: Well-cushioned and very overweight but not American

parts.note: so means very, as in so tired

indicators.note: but not means the abbreviation for American is left out of the word for overweight

parts.note: fat means overweight

explanation.surface: Someone well padded and very heavy, though not from the United States.
explanation.walkthrough: 'but not American' drops A from FAT, leaving FT.
explanation.definitionFit: A well-cushioned seat is plush and yielding to sit on.

clue.text: Date enemy plot organised movement of troops

indicators.note: organised means the letters of enemy plot are arranged afresh

explanation.surface: An enemy schemes to fix a day for an army manoeuvre.
explanation.walkthrough: 'organised' rearranges ENEMY PLOT into EPLOYMENT.
explanation.definitionFit: Deployment is the positioning of forces ready for action.

clue.text: Fawn caught by crude line

parts.note: C is the cricket abbreviation for caught
crude means raw, unrefined

explanation.surface: A young deer is trapped by a rough cord.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fawn' looks like the animal but is the verb, to flatter servilely.
explanation.definitionFit: To crawl to someone is to grovel and flatter them, as a fawning person does.

clue.text: Swearing to bag duck when hunting

indicators.note: to bag means to capture, so the word for swearing holds the duck

parts.note: cursing is swearing
a duck in cricket is a score of nothing, O

explanation.surface: A hunter curses on failing to shoot a duck.
explanation.walkthrough: 'duck' is a nought, the letter O, not a bird.
explanation.definitionFit: Coursing is the sport of chasing game, especially hares, with hounds.

clue.text: Restless and wild past involving sex with a tenor

indicators.note: involving means the word for past takes the other pieces inside it

parts.note: ago means in the past
it is a coy word for sex

explanation.surface: A wild history that included a fling with an operatic tenor.
explanation.definitionFit: Agitato is a musical direction meaning to be played in an agitated, restless way.

clue.text: Endless journeys by plane bring insight

indicators.note: endless means the first and last letters of the word are cut off

parts.note: flights are journeys by air

explanation.surface: Constant air travel gives a person a new perspective.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Endless' trims both ends from FLIGHTS.
explanation.definitionFit: To throw light on something is to give understanding, so light here is enlightenment.

clue.text: Scrub everything from top of cabinet to start with

indicators.note: to start with puts that letter at the front
top of means the first letter of cabinet is used

parts.note: all means everything
off can mean from, as in off the shelf

explanation.surface: Clean every surface, starting at the top of the cupboard.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Scrub' reads as cleaning but means cancel.
explanation.definitionFit: To scrub a plan is slang for cancelling it, which is calling it off.

clue.text: Endless excrement and wee — start of glamorous job of being mother

indicators.note: endless means each of the two words loses its final letter

parts.note: poo is excrement
wee is urine

indicators.note: start of means the first letter of glamorous

explanation.surface: Nappies full of poo and wee: the unglamorous start of motherhood.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Endless' trims POO to PO and URINE to URIN. In Britain, to 'be mother' is to pour the tea for everyone.
explanation.definitionFit: Serving tea from the pot is what the one 'being mother' does at a British tea table.

clue.text: Room where mule possibly hides with last of fodder

indicators.note: hides means the word for a mule holds the abbreviation inside

parts.note: a mule is a backless slipper, an example of footwear

indicators.note: last of means the final letter of fodder

explanation.surface: A stable where a mule hides out with the last of its feed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mule' is not the animal but a backless slipper; 'possibly' marks it as one example.
explanation.definitionFit: A shower room is a bathroom with a cubicle for washing under spraying water.

clue.text: Uniform of heartless senior physician

indicators.note: heartless means the two middle letters are taken out

parts.note: a consultant is a senior hospital doctor in the UK

explanation.surface: The uniform worn by a callous senior doctor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Uniform' looks like clothing but is the adjective meaning unchanging.
explanation.definitionFit: Something uniform stays the same throughout, steady and unvarying.

clue.text: Driving rotten liar out

indicators.note: out means the letters of rotten liar are put out of order

explanation.surface: Driving a lying scoundrel away.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Driving' is not steering a car but the weather sense, as in driving rain.
explanation.definitionFit: Driving rain is heavy and pelting, just like a downpour that falls in torrents.

clue.text: Regularly chastise gossips

indicators.note: regularly means every other letter of chastise is taken

explanation.surface: Tell off people who gossip on a regular basis.
explanation.definitionFit: Spiteful women who gossip are called cats, from their catty remarks.

clue.text: Conservative worn out following public complaint

indicators.note: following puts the abbreviation and the word for worn out after the word for public

parts.note: common means shared by the public
old means worn out

explanation.surface: A grumble from the public about a tired old Tory.
explanation.walkthrough: 'complaint' means an ailment, not a grievance.
explanation.definitionFit: A complaint can be a minor illness, and a head cold is the most everyday one.

clue.text: Mutilate detective society representative

parts.note: DI is Detective Inspector
a member, as of Parliament, is a representative

explanation.surface: A detective accuses a member of a society of mutilation.
explanation.definitionFit: To dismember is to cut a body apart limb by limb.

clue.text: Art works at university are nearly put in filthy place

indicators.note: put in means the pieces go inside the word for a filthy place

parts.note: a sty is a dirty, messy place

indicators.note: nearly means the last letter of are is dropped

explanation.surface: Artworks at a university are almost put in a grimy room.
explanation.walkthrough: 'nearly' trims ARE to AR.
explanation.definitionFit: Statuary is sculpture collectively: statues as works of art.

clue.text: Naked milliner getting in spa and flinging mud around

indicators.note: getting in means the trimmed word goes inside the word for spa

parts.note: a spring is a spa, a source of mineral water

indicators.note: naked means the outer letters are stripped off

parts.note: a hatter is a milliner, a maker of hats

explanation.surface: An undressed hat-maker enters a spa and throws mud about.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spa' is not a resort here but a natural source of mineral water; 'Naked' strips the hat-maker of first and last letters before 'getting in' puts the rest inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Spattering is splashing a liquid or mud about in drops.

clue.text: Friendships absent with times changing around one?

parts.note: A is the abbreviation for absent, as in a register

indicators.note: around means the rearranged letters surround the numeral
changing means the letters of times are rearranged

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Friendships lapse as times change for someone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'changing' rearranges TIMES to MITES, and 'around' wraps it round I to give MITIES.
explanation.definitionFit: Amity is friendliness, so amities are friendly relations.

clue.text: Tracks rogues

definitions.meaning: to track is to follow closely
a dog is a contemptible scoundrel

explanation.surface: Follows the trail of villains.
explanation.definitionFit: One word means both follows someone persistently and worthless scoundrels.

clue.text: Dismissed rising attraction as superficial

parts.note: a batsman dismissed in cricket is out

indicators.note: in a down clue rising means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: a draw is an attraction, something that pulls crowds

explanation.surface: Someone writes off a growing attraction as shallow.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rising' turns DRAW to WARD in this down answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Outward appearance is surface show, so outward means on the surface.

clue.text: Bear engulfed by river flood

indicators.note: engulfed by means the word for bear sits inside the river name

parts.note: the Dee is a river in Wales, England and Scotland
to lug is to carry, to bear a load

explanation.surface: A bear is swept away by a river in spate.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bear' is a verb, carry, not the animal.
explanation.definitionFit: A deluge is a great inundation of water.

clue.text: Meeting involves pastor speaking with vitriol

indicators.note: involves means the word for meeting holds the abbreviation inside

parts.note: a sitting is a session or meeting

explanation.surface: A church meeting where the pastor speaks with venom.
explanation.definitionFit: Spitting words is uttering them angrily and with venom.

clue.text: Way men master rage

parts.note: St is the abbreviation for street, a way
OR, other ranks, are soldiers who are not officers

explanation.surface: A way for men to get on top of their anger.
explanation.definitionFit: To storm is to rage furiously, like a tempest.

clue.text: Kind of horrendous neglect leader of council ignored

indicators.note: horrendous suggests a dreadful mess, so the letters are jumbled
ignored means that letter is left out of neglect
leader of means the first letter of council

explanation.surface: A sort of shocking neglect, the council's leader paying no heed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ignored' drops C from NEGLECT to leave NEGLET, which 'horrendous' rearranges.
explanation.definitionFit: Being gentle means being mild and tender, which is a kindly nature.

clue.text: Dismiss doctor before operation

indicators.note: before places the doctor's abbreviation ahead of the operation's

explanation.surface: Sack the surgeon ahead of the procedure.
explanation.definitionFit: To drop someone from a team is to leave them out or let them go.

clue.text: Social security payment returned with a note on folded paper

indicators.note: returned means the word for the payment is read backwards

parts.note: a giro is a British state benefit payment, once sent as a giro cheque
mi is the third note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: A benefit payment comes back with a note written on folded paper.
explanation.definitionFit: Origami is the Japanese art of folding paper into shapes.

clue.text: Republican centre gets support backing cobblers

parts.note: a hub is a centre

indicators.note: backing means the word for support is reversed

parts.note: a bra is a support garment

explanation.surface: A Republican hub supports the shoemakers' trade.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cobblers' is British slang for nonsense, not shoemakers.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are British slang for rubbish or nonsense talk.

clue.text: Dim male gets first with final piece of philosophy

parts.note: 1st, written with I for 1, means first

indicators.note: final piece of means the last letter of philosophy

explanation.surface: A not-so-bright man comes top with the last part of his philosophy course.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dim' looks like stupid but means hazy.
explanation.definitionFit: Misty means hazy and indistinct, so poorly lit or faint.

clue.text: She can see what you're saying

definitions.text: She can see what you're saying

parts.words: She can see what you're saying
parts.note: seeing speech means reading it off the mouth rather than hearing it, as deaf people may

explanation.surface: A woman who understands you perfectly.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who follows speech by watching mouth movements literally sees words being spoken.
